CORRECTIONS / additions: (1) The ordering advice 'start the init job only after ... AppPlatform sizes are set' is backwards. The real order is init job first, sizes later: MainPage::OnTick (0x1DF8A4) waits for IsAppInitialized (AppMain+0x3C), then calls AttachToPanel 0x1DA634 (sets platform sizes, runs 0x4B55C, client->setSize) and StartRenderLoop. AttachToPanel/setSize BEFORE the job has set client+0xC crashes (setSize -> 0x586EC -> platform NULL). Client init itself calls setSize only with the client's own +0x20/+0x24 (0x1D8552, slot 20), it never reads platform width/height. What the job really needs before it starts is (a) createApp finished its stores (client, platform, LocalFolder strings: all done before RunAsync at 0x1D9FA4) and (b) a live D3D11 device/DeviceResources (MaterialManager::load -> D3DCompile at 0x580D0, textures); the AppMain ctor continues after createApp with DR::setOwner (0x1D9D90), which the render loop (not the init job) needs. (2) createApp releases the returned IAsyncAction immediately (ldr [r3,#8] Release at 0x1D9FAE) and then the handler (0x1D9FB8), so the fake must hold its own references for the lifetime of the worker. (3) The pointer passed to RunAsync is the delegate object itself (r0 = result of 0x1D9B68); COM-level Invoke is vtbl slot 3 at offset 0 of it.
